seoTitle: How to Call eBay Customer Service (USA, UK, Australia)
metaDescription: Find eBay customer service phone numbers for the USA, UK, and Australia in 2026, plus how to use the Call Us option and OTP for live support.
intro: Getting a live agent on the phone can resolve purchase issues, refunds, or account problems faster than waiting on email support. This guide covers how to reach eBay customer service by phone in the USA, UK, and Australia, along with tips to avoid long wait times.

steps.heading: Go to the Help & Contact section
steps.body: From eBay's website or app, navigate to Help & Contact to find the available support options for your issue.

steps.heading: Use the Call Us option
steps.body: Select 'Call Us' to get the correct, currently active support number based on your account's region.

steps.heading: Generate your one-time passcode
steps.body: eBay may require a one-time passcode (OTP) for phone verification before connecting you with a live agent, especially for account-related issues.

steps.heading: Use the region-specific numbers
steps.body: For general contact, eBay lists numbers such as 1-866-540-3229 in the USA, 0800 358 6551 in the UK, and 1800 322 928 in Australia, though the in-app Call Us option always shows the most current number.

steps.heading: Try chat or message center as a backup
steps.body: If phone lines are busy, eBay's chat support or message center can be a faster alternative for less urgent issues.

faq.question: Do I need to be logged in to call eBay customer service?
faq.answer: Yes, for many account-specific queries, eBay requires you to be logged in and may ask for a one-time passcode to verify your identity.

faq.question: Are eBay's phone numbers the same in every country?
faq.answer: No, eBay provides different support numbers for each region, such as separate numbers for the USA, UK, and Australia.

faq.question: What's the best time to call eBay to avoid long wait times?
faq.answer: Calling during off-peak hours, typically early morning or later in the evening in your local time zone, tends to reduce wait times.

faq.question: Can I get help from eBay without calling?
faq.answer: Yes, eBay's chat support and message center are useful backup options if phone lines are busy or you prefer not to call.
